$comment: Checked in and shared. settings.local.json stays gitignored for personal overrides. The deny list is the part that matters: every entry is a rule this repo already learned the hard way. NOT positions.db: denying it made the file unwritable to the whole sandbox, and positions.db() runs its CREATE-IF-NOT-EXISTS trigger script on every connect, so the audit died with 'attempt to write a readonly database'. The no-delete rule is enforced by pos_no_delete and pos_log_no_delete inside the database, which binds every connection including a shell one-liner. A permission on a 20KB binary bought nothing and cost the audit.
